description:
Our project "Lens on MashMesh" is a Lens extension (but an independent effort) on MashMesh.knn3.xyz. MashMesh is a web3 search engine for EVM users, which is fully backed by EVM users' multi-chain user data. In this Hackathon, we built a new extension specifically for Lens users.

On https://Social.MashMesh.knn3.xyz, you can put in anyone's ENS / Lens handle name / Ethereum address to explore one's social relationship on Lens protocol. Not like the traditional list view, in LensOnMashMesh, you can explore social relations in graph style, which means you can literally see the original view of the social network.

You are also allowed to see the Lens profile on the side of graph visuals and follow the one seamlessly with simple click.
how_its_made:
MashMesh search engine is backed by GraphX, a graph-based high-performance multi-chain social data protocol by KNN3 Network. It aggregates users' multi-chain user assets, social status & behavioral data all in one place.

Also, Lens on MashMesh fully integrates Lens protocol's profileNFT & FollowingNFT, the user allows to
- Check one's Lens profile and social status in visualized graph way;
- Find interesting Lens friends through the multi-dimension network of assets/events/social status & other on-chain behaviors.
(Check our demo -> https://social.mashmesh.knn3.xyz)
